# Tips GitHub's activity record lists that origin no longer serves, each one reviewed by hand
# (.github/scripts/fork-secret-scan.sh, "sweep, gone tips"). The daily secret sweep fails on any such
# tip not named here. It reads this file from the default branch only, so a line counts once its pull
# request is merged.
#
# One line per tip: <full commit id> <why it is known gone: how it was checked, and when>.
# Add a line only after looking for the commit on GitHub (its commit page, or
# `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/<id>`): when GitHub still shows it, read it for a key first
# and rotate any key found. A line that is not of this form fails the sweep.
# Remove a line when the sweep warns that origin serves the tip again (it is then scanned).
